label: drop the marker check: the deps/migrations/auth hold always holds, so an owner-approved PR can never pass
accept a marker with no quote: the owner's own words stop being required
ignore the approved pr number: a stale marker approves a later PR on the same slug
old: [ "$last" = "pr $pr" ] || { CEO_OK_REASON="the marker does not approve PR #$pr (last field: ${last:-none})"; return 1; }

label: forget the .blocked exemption: a held deps/migrations/auth PR is skipped even after the owner approved it
release a .blocked written after the marker: a re-block is re-verified (gate + review) every dispatch
forget the label exemption: a needs-ceo/hold PR is skipped even after the owner approved it
old: for l in $ls; do case "$l" in hold|needs-ceo) ceo_ok_clears_hold "$slug" "$pr" || { echo "labelled hold (needs CEO)"; return 0; } ;; esac; done
new: for l in $ls; do case "$l" in hold|needs-ceo) { echo "labelled hold (needs CEO)"; return 0; } ;; esac; done

label: release the label on any non-empty marker: a stale marker from a reused slug merges a red-line PR
